title: Environment waypoint
description: A named navigation point as stored for an environment: the row's columns and payload, before any read-time defaults. A missing or null pose column is reported, because readers silently turn it into zero.

id.description: Stable id, unique within the environment and type.

name.description: Display name. May be empty: readers then show a numbered fallback.

position.description: Position in the environment frame, metres.

rotation.description: Orientation as a quaternion. Writers are expected to keep it unit length; the schema cannot say so.

collection.description: Name of the collection the waypoint belongs to.

frame.description: Frame the pose is expressed in. Absent or null means the environment frame.

type.description: What the pose is relative to.

motion_space.description: Whether the pose is on a surface or free in space.
